{{DGA awards short description|works-year=2019}}

The '''72nd Directors Guild of America Awards''', honoring the outstanding directorial achievement in feature [[Film director|films]], [[Documentary film|documentary]], [[Television director|television]] and [[Television advertisement|commercials]] of 2019, were presented on January 25, 2020, at the [[Ritz-Carlton]] in Downtown Los Angeles, California.<ref>{{cite news |title=DGA Awards: Sam Mendes and '1917' Win Best Feature Film |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/lists/dga-awards-2020-winners-list-full-1270007 |access-date=January 26, 2020 |work=The Hollywood Reporter |date=January 25, 2020}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |last1=Vary |first1=Adam |title=Sam Mendes Wins Top DGA Award for '1917' |url=https://variety.com/2020/film/awards/dga-winners-list-directors-guild-2020-1203478781/ |access-date=January 26, 2020 |work=Variety |date=January 25, 2020}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=72nd Annual DGA Awards Winners |url=https://www.dga.org/News/PressReleases/2020/200125-DGA-Awards-Winners.aspx |publisher=Directors Guild of America |access-date=January 26, 2020 |date=January 25, 2020}}</ref> The ceremony was hosted by [[Judd Apatow]], who also hosted the [[70th Directors Guild of America Awards|ceremony in 2018]].<ref>{{cite web |last1=Evans |first1=Greg |title=Judd Apatow Returns To Host 72nd DGA Awards |url=https://deadline.com/2020/01/judd-apatow-dga-awards-host-don-mischer-awards-chair-1202825914/ |website=Deadline Hollywood |access-date=January 10, 2020 |date=January 9, 2020}}</ref> The nominations for most of the television and documentary categories were announced on January 6, 2020,<ref>{{cite news |last1=Nordyke |first1=Kimberly |title=DGA Awards Unveils Partial List of TV, Documentary and Commercial Nominations |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/lists/dga-awards-2020-nominations-tv-documentary-commercial-nominees-1265675 |access-date=January 7, 2020 |work=The Hollywood Reporter |date=January 6, 2020}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=DGA Announces 2019 Awards Nominees for: Movies for Television & Limited Series; Variety/Talk/News/Sports – Regularly Scheduled Programming; Reality Programs; Children's Programs; Commercials; and Documentary |url=https://www.dga.org/News/PressReleases/2020/200106-72nd-Annual-DGA-Awards-Television-Nominees-Announced.aspx |publisher=Directors Guild of America |access-date=January 7, 2020 |date=January 6, 2020}}</ref> while the nominations for the feature film categories were announced on January 7, 2020.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Sharf |first1=Zack |title=Directors Guild of America 2020 Nominees Include Taika Waititi, Bong Joon Ho, and More |url=https://www.indiewire.com/2020/01/dga-nominations-best-director-2020-1202201273/ |website=IndieWire |access-date=January 7, 2020 |date=January 7, 2020}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=DGA Announces Nominees for Outstanding Directorial Achievement in Theatrical Feature Film for 2019 |url=https://www.dga.org/News/PressReleases/2020/200107-72nd-Annual-DGA-Awards-Feature-Film-Nominees-Announced.aspx |publisher=Directors Guild of America |access-date=January 7, 2020 |date=January 7, 2020}}</ref> The nominations announcement for three television awards (Comedy Series, Drama Series, and Variety/Talk/News/Sports – Specials) was moved to January 10, 2020, due to a re-vote delay.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Pedersen |first1=Erik |title=DGA Awards TV Series Nominations: 'Thrones', 'Watchmen', 'Succession', 'Mrs. Maisel' 'Veep' & 'Barry' |url=https://deadline.com/2020/01/director-guild-awards-tv-nominations-2020-game-of-thrones-marvelous-mrs-maisel-watchmen-veep-barry-succession-1202826894/ |website=Deadline Hollywood |access-date=January 11, 2020 |date=January 10, 2020}}</ref>
